lines.text: The LORD, who formed Israel from the womb, says Jerusalem will be inhabited and the cities of Judah rebuilt.
The LORD says He will dry up the currents of the sea and calls Cyrus His priest.
The LORD grasps Cyrus's right hand and promises to break down gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.
For the sake of Jacob and Israel, the LORD calls Cyrus by name, though Cyrus has not known Him.
The Mighty One of Jacob made the earth and will have Cyrus rebuild His city.
